p3_b0.ocr: In the financial analysis of América Móvil for the period ending December 2023, various metrics are evaluated, showcasing its performance in comparison to other telecommunications companies in the Asia-Pacific region. América Móvil exhibits a P/E Ratio of 12.3, a Current Ratio of 1.5, a Debt/Equity ratio of 0.4, a Return on Equity (ROE) of 8.5%, a Return on Assets (ROA) of 7.2%, a Dividend Yield of 3.0%, an EV/EBITDA of 15.4, and a Net Profit Margin of 15.4%. In comparison, T-Mobile has a P/E Ratio of 11.8, a Current Ratio of 1.8, a Debt/Equity ratio of 0.5, an ROE of 9.1%, an ROA of 6.5%, a Dividend Yield of 2.5%, an EV/EBITDA of 14.2, and a Net Profit Margin of 14.2%.
